title: 1 What is thy onely comfort in life and death?

segments.text:
THat both in ſoule, & body, whether I liue or die, I am not mine own, but belong wholy vnto my moſt faithful Lord & Sauiour Ieſus Chriſt: who by his precious blood moſt fullie ſatisfying for all my ſinnes hath deliue
•ed mee from all the power of the diuell, and ſo reſerueth me, that without the will of my hea
•enly Father, not ſo much as a haire may fal from •y head: yea all thinges muſt ſerue for my ſafe
•y. Wherefore by his Spirit alſo he aſſureth mee •f euerlaſting life, and maketh me ready, and pre
•ared, that henceforth I may liue to him.
